name: Stability Ball Lower Back Stretch
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs apart and the stability ball between your thighs.
Wrap both arms loosely around the ball and let your upper body round forward over it.
Ease into a gentle stretch across your back and hold while breathing comfortably.
Release the ball and slowly bring your torso upright.
tips: Keep your sitting bones on the floor as you fold forward.
Let the ball support your chest without forcing your head down.
